title: subtractiveLoft
body:
## subtractiveLoft

Remove material through an ordered list of unused closed Body-owned profiles while continuing the current base. Section order follows the cut progression; ruled chooses straight spans. The native subtractive loft must remove positive material and leave one solid; incompatible sections or self-intersections fail explicitly.

Native binding: `PartDesign::SubtractiveLoft`. Output kind: `["solid"]`.

| Input port | Multiplicity | Required | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `body` | one node | yes | `body` |
| `sections` | nonempty list | yes | `profile` |
| `base` | one node | no | `solid` |

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ruled` | False (default) interpolates a smooth loft between sections; true uses straight ruled spans. Incompatible profiles and self-intersection remain native geometry failures. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `false` |
